title: executive-daily-priorities-amelia-chen-2026-03-11
content:
Morning scratchpad - quick, messy notes (Amelia)
Date: 2026-03-11

High-level weekly goals (Wk of 3/9)
- Finalize Dedicated capacity pricing tiers + internal comms (target: EOD Thu)
- Approve rollout plan for v2 autoscaler (canary next week)
- Confirm Private deployment pilot onboarding for BetaCo (legal + infra checklist)
- Review Q1 LLM cost regressions and mitigation proposals from Optimize team

Today - top 5 priorities
1) 9:00 AM - Exec sync (30m) - focus: revenue ops + sales pipeline gaps
   - Ask: what is blocker for three key BAU accounts? (Samira update)
   - Prep: 2 bullets on Dedicated capacity demand forecast
2) 10:15 AM - Deep dive w/ serving-runtime (45m) - autoscaler metrics
   - Bring recent p99 latency vs batch size chart (Ravi to share)
   - Decide canary schedule + rollback criteria (SLOs to reference: latency < 120ms p95)
3) 12:00 PM - Lunch + 1:1 w/ Head of Product (30m)
   - Agenda: product roadmap prioritization, timeboxed ask for console UX improvements
4) 2:00 PM - Customer call (BetaCo) - Private deployment kickoff (60m)
   - Confirm infra access, KMS requirements, timeline expectations
   - Ask solutions-eng for runbook & onboarding owner (Elena?)
5) 4:00 PM - Review Optimize proposals (30m)
   - Quick read: quant profiles + expected per-token cost delta

Quick notes / prep items
- Slides for exec sync: 2 slides - (a) revenue funnel highlight, (b) Dedicated commit ask. Draft in Google Slides: link in linked_artifacts.
- Pull Dedicated commit forecast: finance model (JIRA-ENG-1138) - check revised numbers from Priya.
- Autoscaler: need clear rollback triggers -> add to canary doc: "if error rate > 0.5% for 5m, revert"
- BetaCo legal: NDA signed 3/5, follow-up on data residency clarifications. Add to meeting: confirm region and log retention settings.

Follow-ups from yesterday
- Action: schedule infra runbook review with solutions-eng by Fri - assigned to Elena (pending)
- Action: get gated list of models for canary from Applied ML - Ravi to send by EOD
- Action: finance requested list of customers we want to convert to Dedicated pilot - I sent initial list, waiting response from Sales (Samira)

Open questions / risks
- If autoscaler canary shows tail-latency increases, do we delay Dedicated commits? (need cross-team decision matrix)
- BetaCo timeline: tight (4 weeks). Do we offer interim hosted API with private links while on-prem gets ready?
- Legal review for Private deployment terms: ensure indemnity clause doesn't block pilot.

Quick todo (today) - scratch checklist
- [ ] Finalize exec slides (30m)
- [ ] Confirm Ravi's chart + shared folder link (10m)
- [ ] Email Solutions Eng to confirm runbook owner (5m)
- [ ] Prep BetaCo kickoff agenda + send pre-read (15m)
- [ ] Read Optimize summary (15m)

Notes to self (stream-of-consciousness)
- Keep canary small: pick low-risk region, subset of traffic, single model variant.
- Emphasize cost tradeoffs when talking to sales - customers care about predictability more than raw latency improvements.
- Remind product to gate large UX changes behind telemetry signals; avoid big console rewrites this quarter.

Later / backlog (non-urgent)
- Review quarterly OKRs for infra reliability (align with SRE)
- Prep one-pager on "how Redwood reduces inference cost" for sales enablement
- Follow up with compliance on SOC2 timeline (next month)

End notes: keep this doc ephemeral - merge key action items into tasks in Jira/Asana after meetings.

-- Amelia
